title: Cam predictive cortex — outcome prediction from experience
authorization_note: Aaron 2026-09-22: research plan + deep dive on deep learning networks and predictive measures based on experiences; 'enhance Cam'. Prediction is advisory (report-only). Closing the loop — letting predictions alter routing or fire motors — still requires switch.cam_enhance.

predictive_measures.p_success: Beta-Bernoulli posterior mean with exponential forgetting (half_life_days) and hierarchical backoff hotspot→pattern→center→sense→global
predictive_measures.credible_interval: central 90% Beta credible interval (stdlib incomplete beta)
predictive_measures.expected_score: recency-weighted mean/std of 0-100 scores at the finest context with evidence
predictive_measures.td_value: TD(0) value V ← V + α(r − V) per context; r = score/100 or ok
predictive_measures.surprise: |reward prediction error| per update — plasticity signal for center.qa
predictive_measures.calibration: prequential Brier, log loss, ECE, AUROC, Brier skill vs running base rate, score MAE + 90% interval coverage
